name: abcEconomics
description: abcEconomics is a Python-based agent-based modeling framework used to simulate economic systems with decentralized agents. It serves as a benchmark environment for testing economic behaviors, learning dynamics, and distributed decision-making. The focus is on scalability and flexibility of agent interactions.
reputation: Widely used in computational economics and social simulation communities.
notes: Framework rather than a fixed benchmark; results depend heavily on user-defined models.

scientists: J. P. G. van der Hoog
